patch_description: Crossover combining the current program's fast vectorized geometry kernel and diverse seed generator (lattice, golden-ratio, repulsion layouts) with the best-performing prior annealer (score 0.70): membership-weighted bottleneck point selection, correlated two-point moves, occasional global jitter, simulated annealing with exponential cooling, and a multi-scale 8-directional coordinate polish. I extend the polish to iterate over the top bottleneck points rather than only the single worst one, and add a short greedy fine-polish pass at the end. The seed set is trimmed to the most promising families to keep total runtime near 1-2 seconds while maximizing min area.
